어제.forms: 어제가 · 어제는 · also used as an adverb (어제 갔어요)
어제.e: Also 어저께 in speech; 그저께 = the day before yesterday.

요일.x: What day of the week is it today?
요일.e: Each weekday is named after the sun, the moon, or one of five planets.
요일.t: Day of the week: 무슨 요일이에요? Date: 며칠이에요?

배고프다.x: I'm hungry because I didn't eat breakfast.
배고프다.e: 배 (stomach) + 고프다 (empty). 배 also means pear and boat.
배고프다.t: Often said with a particle: 배가 고파요.

기념.x: I took photos with my family to mark my graduation.
기념.t: ~ 기념으로 means 'to mark or celebrate ~': 생일 기념으로 'for my birthday.'

노인.x: There are seats for seniors on the subway.
노인.t: 노인 is neutral or official; when speaking to or about an elder politely, use 어르신.

자기.x: The child cleaned his own room by himself.
자기.t: Couples also call each other 자기 ('honey'); otherwise it refers back to the subject of the sentence.

대신.x: I gave the presentation instead of my sick friend.
대신.e: Literally 'replacing body' — standing in someone's place.
대신.t: N 대신 means 'instead of N'; V-는 대신 often means 'in exchange for doing'.

품질.x: This bag is expensive, but the quality is good.

가능성.x: There's a high chance of rain tomorrow.
가능성.t: Pronounced [가능썽]: the ㅅ in -성 is usually tensed.

뛰어나다.ex: 그 학생은 수학 실력이 정말 뛰어나요.
뛰어나다.x: That student is really outstanding at math.
뛰어나다.e: Built from 뛰다 'to jump' + 나다 'to come out': someone who jumps out ahead.

도구.ex: 이 도구를 사용하면 쉽게 고칠 수 있어요.
도구.x: If you use this tool, you can fix it easily.
도구.e: Literally 'equipment for the way' of doing a task.

교환 학생.ex: 저는 다음 학기에 일본에 교환 학생으로 가요.
교환 학생.x: Next semester I'm going to Japan as an exchange student.

커플.ex: 두 사람은 정말 잘 어울리는 커플이에요.
커플.x: They really are a perfect couple.
커플.e: From English 'couple'; Konglish spin-offs include 커플룩 'matching outfits' and 커플링 'couple rings'.

불리하다.ex: 비가 와서 우리 팀에 불리한 경기였어요.
불리하다.x: It rained, so the game was unfavorable for our team.

졸졸.x: The stream in the valley trickles along.
졸졸.e: Sound and manner word (의성어·의태어) for a thin stream of water. Bright-vowel 졸졸 is small and gentle; dark-vowel 줄줄 is a heavier flow, as in 땀이 줄줄 흘러요 'sweat is pouring down'.
졸졸.t: 졸졸 따라다니다 means 'to tag along after someone', like a child following a parent.

사내.e: Literally 'inside the company'; mostly used before another noun.
사내.t: Homonym warning: native 사내 means 'man, guy' — context makes it clear.

알뜰하다.ex: 제 언니는 알뜰해서 돈을 많이 모았어요.
알뜰하다.x: My older sister is thrifty, so she has saved a lot of money.
알뜰하다.e: Doubled form 알뜰살뜰 means 'very thrifty and careful with the household'.
알뜰하다.t: A positive word for smart saving; 알뜰폰 = budget phone plan, 알뜰 시장 = flea market.

교향곡.x: Beethoven's Symphony No. 9 is famous around the world.
교향곡.e: Literally 'piece where sounds mingle and resound'.

결말.x: The ending of that movie was so sad.

판결.ex: 법원은 다음 주에 최종 판결을 내릴 예정입니다.
판결.x: The court is scheduled to deliver its final ruling next week.
판결.t: Use 판결을 내리다 'to hand down a ruling' and 판결이 나오다 'a ruling comes out'.

걸맞다.x: He received treatment befitting his skills.
걸맞다.e: Pattern: N에 걸맞다 — 'matching N, fitting for N'.
걸맞다.t: It's an adjective, so the modifier is 걸맞은, not 걸맞는 — a very common mistake even among natives.

반신반의.ex: 처음에는 친구가 말한 그 소문을 반신반의했어요.
반신반의.x: At first I was half doubtful about the rumor my friend told me.

활개를 치다.forms: 활개를 쳐요 · 활개를 쳤어요 · 활개를 치고 다니다
활개를 치다.m: to act freely and boldly; to run rampant
활개를 치다.ex: 요즘 인터넷에서 가짜 뉴스가 활개를 치고 있어요.
활개를 치다.x: Fake news is running rampant online these days.
활개를 치다.e: 활개 = outspread arms or a bird's spread wings; picture flapping them freely.

뒷받침.x: We need data to back up that claim.
뒷받침.e: 뒤 'back' + 받치다 'to prop up': propping something up from behind.
뒷받침.t: Pronounced [뒤빧침]; 뒷받침하다 means 'to back up', often with claims and evidence.

배경지식.ex: 배경지식이 있으면 글을 더 쉽게 이해할 수 있어요.
배경지식.x: With background knowledge, you can understand a text more easily.
배경지식.e: Literally 'backdrop knowledge': what you already know behind the text.

여건.ex: 경제적 여건이 좋지 않아서 유학을 포기했어요.
여건.x: I gave up studying abroad because my financial situation wasn't good.
여건.e: Literally 'given items': the conditions you have to work with.
여건.t: Pronounced [여껀]; 여건이 되다 means 'circumstances allow', often about money or time.

토대.ex: 어릴 때의 경험이 지금 제 성격의 토대가 됐어요.
토대.x: My childhood experiences became the foundation of my personality.
토대.e: Literally 'earth platform': the base a building stands on.
토대.t: Pattern: N을/를 토대로 'based on N', e.g. 조사 결과를 토대로 'based on the survey results'.

수반.x: The president is the head of state and the head of the executive branch.
수반.e: Literally 'head of the ranks'; a homonym 수반 means 'accompanying'.

세속적.ex: 그는 세속적 가치에 얽매이지 않고 살아요.
세속적.x: He lives without being tied down by worldly values.

대비되다.m: to be contrasted, to stand in contrast
대비되다.ex: 밝은 색 옷이 어두운 배경과 잘 대비됩니다.
대비되다.x: The bright clothes contrast well with the dark background.
대비되다.e: Literally 'set facing each other and compared.'
대비되다.t: A homonym 대비 (different hanja) means 'preparation': 시험에 대비하다 'to prepare for an exam.'

가차 없이.forms: 가차 없이 처벌하다 · 가차 없는 + noun
가차 없이.ex: 규칙을 어기는 사람은 가차 없이 처벌합니다.
가차 없이.x: Anyone who breaks the rules will be punished without mercy.
가차 없이.e: 가차 means 'lending, leniency' — giving no leeway at all.
가차 없이.t: 가차 is almost never used alone; it appears in 가차 없이 or 가차 없는.

뜸을 들이다.forms: 뜸을 들여요 · 뜸을 들였어요 · 뜸 들이지 말고
뜸을 들이다.m: to hesitate before speaking; to keep someone in suspense; (cooking) to let rice steam
뜸을 들이다.ex: 뜸을 들이지 말고 결과를 빨리 말해 주세요.
뜸을 들이다.x: Stop stalling and tell me the results already.
뜸을 들이다.e: From cooking: letting rice sit and steam after boiling before you open the lid.
뜸을 들이다.t: 뜸 들이지 말고 = 'don't keep me in suspense' — very common in casual speech.

체제.x: The company has switched to emergency management mode.
체제.e: Literally 'body and control' — how an organization is run.

정당화.ex: 어떤 이유로도 폭력은 정당화될 수 없어요.
정당화.x: Violence cannot be justified for any reason.

빈혈.x: I have anemia, so I feel dizzy when I stand up suddenly.

품새.ex: 승급 심사 때문에 품새를 매일 연습해요.
품새.x: I practice my forms every day for the belt test.
품새.e: Replaced the older Sino-Korean term 품세 (品勢 'form-posture'). It is often explained as native 품 'manner' + -새 'look' (as in 모양새), but that derivation is not established.
품새.t: Each 품새 is a fixed sequence of blocks, punches and kicks against imaginary opponents (태극 1장, 2장…), and it is also a competition event.

비듬.x: I had a lot of dandruff, so I changed my shampoo.

기피인물.ex: 정부는 그 외교관을 기피인물로 지정하고 추방했습니다.
기피인물.x: The government declared the diplomat persona non grata and expelled him.

보시.ex: 스님은 보시가 마음을 나누는 일이라고 말씀하셨어요.
보시.x: The monk said that almsgiving is a way of sharing your heart.
보시.e: Literally 'spreading and giving'; this first syllable is usually read 포, as in 포교.

고전주의.ex: 고전주의 예술은 균형과 질서를 중요하게 생각했습니다.
고전주의.x: Classicist art placed great value on balance and order.
고전주의.e: Literally 'old-canon-ism' — modeled on Greek and Roman classics.

동학농민운동.x: The Donghak Peasant Revolution broke out in 1894 under Jeon Bong-jun's leadership.
동학농민운동.t: Pronounced [동항농미눈동] — ㄱ becomes ㅇ before ㄴ.

와전되다.m: to be misreported, to be distorted (in passing along)
와전되다.x: My words got twisted along the way, and a misunderstanding arose.
와전되다.e: Literally 'transmitted with errors', like a game of telephone.

사뿐하다.x: She stepped onto the stage with light steps.
사뿐하다.e: Related to the adverb 사뿐 'lightly', as in 사뿐사뿐.

어슴푸레.ex: 안개 속에서 멀리 산이 어슴푸레 보였어요.
어슴푸레.x: The mountain was faintly visible far off in the fog.
어슴푸레.e: Also as the adjective 어슴푸레하다; used for dim light, blurry sight and hazy memories.

어로불변.m: utter illiteracy, unable to tell similar letters apart
어로불변.ex: 어로불변이던 그가 지금은 책을 쓰는 작가가 되었어요.
어로불변.x: He once couldn't tell one letter from another, but now he's an author.
어로불변.e: Unable to tell apart two similar-looking characters, 'fish' and 'Lu'.

요산요수.m: loving mountains and rivers, enjoying nature
요산요수.x: My grandfather lives in the countryside, enjoying the mountains and streams.
요산요수.e: From Confucius: the wise delight in water, the virtuous delight in mountains.
요산요수.t: Here the syllable 요 means 'to enjoy' — the same character is read 락 or 악 elsewhere, a classic reading trap.

평지풍파.m: stirring up trouble out of nowhere
평지풍파.x: Don't stir up trouble with unnecessary remarks.
평지풍파.e: Literally 'wind and waves on flat ground' — trouble where all was calm.
평지풍파.t: Collocates with 일으키다: 평지풍파를 일으키다 'to make waves for no reason.'
